markdown: Water pools on the compacted path after rain. Shade lowered the garden temperature in one afternoon trial. Neither observation establishes long-term yield.

puzzles.question: How can we test water drainage without assuming a cause?
How can we test garden heat exposure with limited observations?

owner_reviewed_purposes: Design a water drainage comparison with a measured infiltration time and an unchanged control path.
Design a heat exposure comparison with repeated temperature measurements and an unshaded control.
